verdict.rationale: Publishing third-party authorization forms, delegated roles, and rules on which signatures must stay personal is a fair question for a state business-filing agency like the SCC, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes; no SCC content was fetched, so there is no evidence of published delegation rules, forms, or signature limits. The robots.txt findings are not about delegated access and do not bear on this story.
